summary: Tested all 4 new features through the public preview URL, using both the API and the UI. (1) Distribution progress: the overlay appears about 0.1s after clicking candidate-create. Steps are styled correctly (done steps green, current step bold), elapsed time counts up, and remaining shows 'en fazla N sn'. Solutions and best result update live (0 -> 1, 'henüz yok' -> '0 öğrenci'). The overlay closes when the solve ends and a new candidate card appears (solve took 2-6s). The GET progress endpoint keeps responding while a solve is running (lock-free; 7 snapshots in 3.5s). Stop works on both paths: (a) before any solution, the card shows 'Dağıtım durduruldu; henüz geçerli bir çözüm bulunmamıştı...'; (b) after the first solution, a candidate is saved and the API returns stopped_early=true with outcome 'stopped'. The stop endpoint returns 409 when nothing is running. The pinned redistribution panel shows the same overlay, and the new candidate is labelled 'Sabitlemeli alternatif (1 derslik korundu)'. (2) Violation map: I selected a candidate and moved a 10/A student via the plan into the empty seat at the same desk as another 10/A student. The card then shows candidate-violations with 2 students, each listed once, with reasons like 'Aynı şube · yan yana: ÖRNEK AD 015 SENTETİK SOYAD 015 (K2)'. Clicking a student opens the plan and gives the seat the violation-focus class (red) and the neighbour seat violation-neighbor (orange dashed); seats in a violation get has-violation, the legend shows the 3 extra items, and clicking again toggles off. I found and fixed a scroll bug here (see below). (3) Update manager: shows version 0.2.0 and the platform. A non-zip shows 'Güncelleme paketi açılamadı veya bozuk.' and a zip without manifest shows 'Güncelleme paketinde manifest bulunamadı.'. A hand-made valid TEST package (manifest kelebek-update/1, 1 file with SHA-256) shows the preview with the 'geliştirme modunda' note, and the apply button stays disabled even after the confirm box is ticked. API: status is correct, apply without confirm returns 400, apply with confirm returns 409, and a path-traversal zip is rejected. (4) Regression: the iteration-1 lifecycle e2e suite passes 19/19, backend unittests pass 26/26, and report-center confirmation gating still works in the UI.

minor.issue: Any student edit invalidates every DistributionRun of every DRAFT exam that contains the student and clears selected_candidate_id. This includes cosmetic first/last-name edits, which are not part of the fingerprint, and edits that are later reverted. All candidates silently disappear. Seen during this run: the iteration-1 regression suite patches and then restores DEMO-003/DEMO-005, after which 'TEST_UI_Happy kopya' (9 candidates) and 'TEST_API_16ec68 kopya' both showed 0 candidates. `affected += 1` also runs even when nothing changed. Suggestion: only invalidate when class_level/section/area/is_active actually change; update names in place.

distribution_progress.start() is called before the 404/403/409 checks, so failing requests (for example on an archived org) still leave a finished progress entry in the registry. Harmless, but start progress only after validation.

The whole upload is written to disk before MAX_PACKAGE_BYTES is checked, and staged/<token> folders from previews that are never cancelled are never cleaned up. Consider a streaming size check and cleanup of old staged folders on startup.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The seat lookup used document.querySelector('[data-seat-id=...]'), but every candidate card renders the same seats (18 duplicates in the DOM). It matched the seat inside Aday 1's closed <details>, so scrollIntoView did nothing whenever the violating candidate was not the first card. It is now scoped to the candidate's plan-details element; I verified the focused seat scrolls into view.

The label only changes to 'Durduruluyor…' and the button only becomes disabled after the next 500ms poll, so the button can be clicked again. In practice the solve often finishes before the next poll and the label is never shown. Set a local 'stopping' state on click (disable + label immediately).

After 'Vazgeç', file state is cleared but the native input still shows 'valid.zip' while the inspect button is disabled. Choosing the same file again does not fire onChange, so the user cannot re-inspect it without picking another file. Reset the input (ref.value = '' or a key change).

issues: `.exam-candidate-result > div {display:flex}` (specificity 0,1,1) overrides `.candidate-violations {display:grid}`. The title, hint and student buttons end up in one row, and the hint '<small>' gets the generic green chip style (`.exam-candidate-result small`) as a 317x62 green block. Fix: `.exam-candidate-result > .candidate-violations {display:grid}` and reset the background/padding of `.candidate-violations > small`.

design_issues.screen: Yedek ve arşiv - Uygulama güncellemesi card
issues: The heading paragraph is 16px while the sibling backup cards use about 12-13px, which looks inconsistent and oversized.
The file input is native and unstyled (the backup card has a styled file field).
The 'Vazgeç' button uses the browser default style (grey, outset black border, 51px tall) and is misaligned with the apply button.
Small packages show '0.0 MB'; use KB below 1 MB.
Pre-existing: the student name lines under each desk ('K2 · 10/A ÖRNEK AD 015 SENTETİK SOYAD 015') overflow the desk box and overlap the desk below.

action_items: Fix the violations box CSS specificity (grid layout, hint text style).
Give the stop button an immediate local 'Durduruluyor…' / disabled state on click.
Reset the update file input on cancel; style the update card's paragraph, file input and Vazgeç button like the backup card; show KB for small packages.
Consider not invalidating draft runs/candidates on name-only or no-op student edits.
Optional: start progress only after request validation; streaming size check and staged-folder cleanup in app_update.
critical_code_review_comments: The global API lock is held for the whole solve (up to 12s). Progress, stop and edit-locks bypass it, but every other API call from any tab (lists, reports, student pages) blocks for the whole solve. A concurrent candidate-create is serialized (it got 201 after waiting) rather than returning the 409 'zaten hesaplanıyor', because the in-progress check runs inside the lock.

The stop endpoint is not tied to the edit-lock owner tab, so a tab in preview mode could stop another tab's solve via the API. The UI only shows the overlay in the tab that started the solve, so the risk is low.
A candidate saved after stop_early is not marked in the UI (stopped_early is only in the POST response); consider labelling it 'Erken durduruldu'.
ExamOrganizer.tsx is now 805 lines; extract the candidate card/plan rendering (including the violation logic) into its own component.
Seat buttons share data-seat-id across candidate cards. Any future document-level lookup must be scoped per candidate, as done in the fix.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 new e2e API + 19/19 lifecycle regression + 26/26 unittests)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; 1 scroll bug fixed, 2 low UI bugs, design issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is in env var preview_endpoint (https://3d869be9-708c-49f0-ba7a-215cf7b3a641.preview.emergentagent.com); there is no frontend/.env. Run: KELEBEK_PUBLIC_URL=<url> /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/e2e/test_progress_violations_updates_e2e.py -p no:cacheprovider (creates 1 TEST_PROG org per run). Update fixtures: python3 tests/e2e/make_update_fixtures.py /tmp/upd linux-arm64 (the platform must match /api/updates/status). The solver is fast (optimal in about 2-6s), so to test stop with a saved candidate, click the stop button from in-page JS as soon as distribution-solutions >= 1. Running test_lifecycle_api_e2e.py wipes the candidates of all draft orgs (student PATCH invalidation). The DB is /root/.local/share/kelebek-sinav-sistemi/kelebek.sqlite3.
rca of the issue: Violation scroll: duplicate data-seat-id across candidate cards plus a document-level querySelector meant the first DOM match was in another candidate's closed <details>, so scrollIntoView did nothing. Fixed by scoping the lookup to the candidate's details element. Candidates disappearing: student_registry.sync_draft_exam_snapshots overwrites every DistributionRun.config_hash with a random value and clears selected_candidate_id for every draft containing the edited student, regardless of which field changed.
